name: Robert Biedroń, Nikolas Farantouris - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on implementation and delivery of the Sustainable Development Goals in view of the 2025 High-Level Political Forum
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position ahead of a United Nations meeting in July 2025 on the Sustainable Development Goals — 17 global targets to be met by 2030. It says the world is far off track and calls on the EU to lead: protect health, reach gender equality, create decent work, protect the oceans and fund development aid. It is an opinion, not a law, so nothing changes directly.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the EU to act and spend more on these goals.
- **Who it affects:** People in poorer countries, women and girls, health workers, fishers and aid recipients.
- **What happens next:** Parliament sends this position to EU governments, the European Commission and the United Nations before the July meeting.
